chunks.title: Dungeon Chase: Where Survival Meets Destruction  (2026)
chunks.text:
Dungeon Chase: Where Survival Meets Destruction (2026). Excited to showcase Dungeon Chase — a 3D Endless Runner developed in Unreal Engine 5.3! This project challenged us to bridge the gap between technical logic and immersive art. While we focused on high-speed mechanics and atmosphere, the true standout feature is our unique Power Mode Mechanic. The Standout Feature: Power Mode
Unlike traditional runners where you only dodge, in Dungeon Chase, you fight back. By collecting 50 daggers, the player triggers an intense 15-second Power Mode. During this window, the gameplay flips: you stop evading and start smashing, gaining the ability to destroy blocker obstacles that would otherwise end your run. This adds a layer of strategy and high-stakes reward that keeps players pushing for that next dagger.

chunks.title: Dungeon Chase: Where Survival Meets Destruction  (2026) (part 2)
chunks.text:
Dungeon Chase: Where Survival Meets Destruction (2026). is adds a layer of strategy and high-stakes reward that keeps players pushing for that next dagger. Core Technical Highlights:
 Procedural World Generation: A modular tile-spawning system that ensures a unique dungeon path every time. Technical Character Integration: Mastered IK Retargeting to bring a custom Viking model to life with fluid movement. Dynamic HUD: A frame-independent UI progress bar that tracks Power Mode duration in real-time. Building Dungeon Chase was an incredible hands-on experience in problem-solving and teamwork. From mastering the dark dungeon atmosphere to implementing complex event-driven logic, every phase strengthened our understanding of the Unreal ecosystem.

chunks.title: CYBERNEX SIMULATOR:
chunks.text:
CYBERNEX SIMULATOR:. Excited to share our semester project of Data Structures And Algorithms "Cybernex Simulator" at NED University of Engineering and Technology
 We are thrilled that Cybernex Simulator was selected as one of the top projects in the department and also got the privilege to showcase it in the project exhibition, making this journey even more rewarding! About the Project
Cybernex Simulator is an innovative game that blends cybersecurity challenges with a graph-based environment. Each node represents a unique task, allowing players to navigate through decoding encrypted messages, cracking passwords, bypassing firewalls, and number guessing—challenges inspired by real-world cybersecurity scenarios.

chunks.title: VR ESCAPE ROOM (2026)
chunks.text:
VR ESCAPE ROOM (2026). VR Escape – Immersive VR Horror Escape Game
Unity | C# | XR Interaction Toolkit | Virtual Reality 
I collaborated on developing an immersive VR horror escape game using Unity and the XR Interaction Toolkit. The game places players inside an abandoned multi-room house, where they must explore their surroundings, locate four hidden keys, and unlock the exit before the countdown timer expires. 
I worked on creating an interactive VR gameplay experience featuring object grabbing, collectible-based progression, teleportation, and randomized gameplay mechanics. The key collection system allows players to physically pick up objects using VR interactions, while randomized spawn locations ensure that each playthrough offers a different exploration experience.

I also worked with VR-specific UI implementation using World Space Canvas to display the timer, collected key count, and gameplay status within the virtual environment.

chunks.title: PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026)
chunks.text:
PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026). CYBERVERSE — Beyond the Firewall | Interactive First-Person 3D Experience 
Technologies: JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL, GLSL, Vite, HTML5, CSS3 
I developed CYBERVERSE – Beyond the Firewall, an interactive, browser-based 3D experience inspired by cybersecurity and digital network environments. The project takes players through two connected worlds: a futuristic Cybersecurity Command Center and an encrypted Cyber Network. 
Players explore the command center in first-person view, interact with a robotic guardian using a raycasting-based targeting system, and activate an EMP override to disable it and unlock a glowing digital portal. Walking through the gateway transitions the player into the second world, where they can explore a network environment and return through a matching gateway.

chunks.title: PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026) (part 2)
chunks.text:
PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026). second world, where they can explore a network environment and return through a matching gateway. 
Key Features & Contributions 
- Procedural 3D Environment Development: Created two connected 3D worlds using Three.js, generating scene geometry, lighting, server racks, holographic panels, data towers, network nodes, and particles directly through code. - First-Person Navigation: Implemented mouse-based camera controls using the Pointer Lock API, keyboard movement with WASD and arrow keys, sprint functionality, and movement boundaries. - Procedural Robot Guardian: Built an animated robot character from 18 primitive 3D meshes, with independently moving parts, a rotating shoulder ring, scanning head, glowing reactor, and energy shield.

chunks.title: PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026) (part 3)
chunks.text: PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026). endently moving parts, a rotating shoulder ring, scanning head, glowing reactor, and energy shield. - Interactive Raycasting: Implemented a targeting system that detects when the player's crosshair is aimed at the robot within a defined distance, enabling contextual interaction. - EMP Override Mechanic: Developed a staged shutdown sequence featuring robot movement, fading energy effects, shield deactivation, and dynamic status updates to unlock the portal. - Live 3D Portal Rendering: Used WebGLRenderTarget to render the second world into a live texture displayed inside the portal, rather than using a static image. - Custom GLSL Shader: Created a ShaderMaterial-based portal effect with animated energy bands, scan lines, ripple effects, and soft edges.

chunks.title: PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026) (part 4)
chunks.text:
PORTAL ASSIGNMENT USING THREE JS (2026). aterial-based portal effect with animated energy bands, scan lines, ripple effects, and soft edges. - Seamless World Transitions: Implemented position-based portal crossing detection, animated transition effects, access restrictions while the guardian is active, and a return gateway. - HUD and Visual Design: Designed a futuristic interface with a crosshair, guardian interaction prompt, status indicators, toast notifications, and animated transition overlays. 
Technical Highlights 
- Two independently managed Three.js scenes using one WebGL renderer. - Procedural geometry and animation without external 3D model or texture files. - Raycaster-based object targeting and interaction. - Render-to-texture pipeline for live portal previews. - Custom GLSL fragment shader effects.

chunks.text:
ALICE IN THE WONDERLAND (TEA PARTY SCENE RECREATION IN UNITY USING VR). Alice in Wonderland – VR Tea Party Experience (2026) 
Unity | C# | XR Interaction Toolkit | Virtual Reality 
I developed an interactive VR-inspired tea party experience using Unity and the XR Interaction Toolkit, inspired by the magical world of Alice in Wonderland. My goal was to recreate a fantasy tea-party environment where users can explore the surroundings and interact naturally with objects. 
I designed and configured the interactive environment, implemented an XR-based player interaction system, and developed object-grabbing mechanics that allow users to pick up and hold teapots naturally. One of the main features I developed was a tilt-based tea-pouring mechanic using custom C# scripting and Unity's Particle System.

The system detects the teapot's orientation and automatically activates or stops the tea particles and pouring sound accordingly. 
I also customized particle effects to simulate a realistic flowing tea stream, integrated background ambience and interaction sounds, designed a main menu using Unity Canvas and TextMeshPro, and implemented scene transitions using Unity SceneManager.

Developed interactive object-grabbing mechanics using XR Grab Interactable. 
Implemented a custom tilt-based tea-pouring system using C#. 
Customized Unity Particle Systems for realistic pouring effects. 
Integrated synchronized audio feedback and background ambience.

The project demonstrates the practical application of computer vision and gesture-based interaction to create a touch-free digital drawing experience.

chunks.title: Islamic Evaluator and Trainer (2025)
chunks.text:
Islamic Evaluator and Trainer (2025). Technologies: Python, Tkinter, MySQL, Pillow (PIL) 
Project Overview
I worked on Islamic Evaluator and Trainer, a desktop-based educational application designed to help users assess and strengthen their knowledge of Islamic studies through interactive evaluations and learning activities. 
The application combines a structured evaluation system with game-based training exercises, making the learning experience more engaging and interactive. 
Key Features
- User Authentication: Registration and login functionality with password hashing and database-backed user accounts. - Knowledge Evaluation: Assessment module with Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels, allowing users to test their Islamic knowledge.

chunks.title: ADOBE AFTER EFFECTS->CREATIVE AGENCY MARKETING VIDEO RECREATION
chunks.text: ADOBE AFTER EFFECTS->CREATIVE AGENCY MARKETING VIDEO RECREATION. As part of CEGA's Post Production Course, I recreated a creative agency promotional video using Adobe After Effects. This project allowed me to explore motion graphics, animated typography, shape transformations, and visual transitions. I focused on recreating the original animation's visual flow while maintaining smooth movement and synchronization between different elements. Through this project, I gained practical experience in building engaging motion graphics and using animation to communicate a brand's identity and creative vision.

chunks.title: DOCUMENTARY-STYLE ANIMATION IN ADOBE AFTER EFFECTS
chunks.text: DOCUMENTARY-STYLE ANIMATION IN ADOBE AFTER EFFECTS. Created as part of CEGA's Post Production Course, this project involved developing a short documentary-style animation featuring the historic Badshahi Mosque in Lahore. Using Adobe After Effects, I combined architectural imagery, animated shapes, typography, and layered visual elements to introduce the monument and highlight its historical significance. I experimented with animation techniques and visual composition to create a documentary-inspired presentation that communicates historical information through engaging visual storytelling.

chunks.title: Orb Rush — overview
chunks.text: Orb Rush (3D Web Game · Three.js). Year: 2026. Team: Individual. A responsive browser-based 3D arcade game with full-stack accounts: authenticated players pop animated orbs in timed rounds, then track results on a personal dashboard and public leaderboard.

chunks.title: Orb Rush — features and build
chunks.text: Orb Rush. Features: Animated orbs in a Three.js arena with lighting, camera controls and raycast pointer interaction; Scoring with normal and bonus orbs, penalties, limited lives, combo multipliers and rising difficulty; 60-second rounds with pause/resume, accuracy tracking and game-over summaries; Personal stats, recent history and a public leaderboard. What was built: Frontend in vanilla JavaScript + Vite; backend APIs with Node.js and Express; MongoDB Atlas + Mongoose for accounts and results; Password hashing, JWT in HTTP-only cookies, input validation, CSRF protection, rate limiting; Server-issued game sessions with server-side result validation; Vercel deployment with GitHub integration and environment variables.

chunks.title: Orb Rush — stack and learning
chunks.text: Orb Rush. Technologies: Three.js, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, JWT, Vercel. Learned: Combining real-time 3D interaction with a secure full-stack architecture. The latest shared local run reported 21 passing tests and a successful production build; live deployment acceptance is a separate check. Media available: Gameplay demo. Live link: https://orb-rush-omega.vercel.app/

chunks.title: Between Waking — overview
chunks.text: Between Waking (Animation Pre-Production · Game Concept). Year: 2026. Team: Team ATE. Aiman's role: Animatics · concept art of Aaron cooking in the kitchen scene. Context: CEGA Pre-Production course — final deliverable. A story of tragedy, discovery and truth: a man’s emotional journey through guilt and redemption, unravelling memories in an alternate dimension. Subtitle: "The Truth in the Shadows — A Journey Through Guilt, Betrayal, and the Path to Forgiveness". Pre-production work only — not a finished animation or game.

chunks.title: Between Waking — features and build
chunks.text: Between Waking. Features: Themes: loss (the emotional aftermath of tragedy), guilt (unresolved feelings and memories) and redemption (the road to healing and acceptance); Characters: Aaron (protagonist, FBI agent — humble, brave, built from rectangles), Mark (antagonist, FBI agent — clever, jealous, built from pointed triangles) and Lily Aaron (his nine-year-old daughter, built from circles); Colour palette tied to story states: Deep Charcoal (FBI / coma state), Crimson Red (conflict, betrayal, nightmare walls), Warm Gold (awakening), Pure White (peace and forgiveness); Worlds: a hospital (the central area where animation and game take place), a home, and surreal alternate-dimension corridors of memory doors; Game concept: the player fills the voids of his memory by solving the NPC’s nightmares — object interaction, search, sequence-based cooking, audio cues, limited visibility and driving control; Level 1 top-down design: a fractured hospital-corridor hub leading to the Promotion, Cooking and Accident nightmares. What was built: Early character sketches defining each character visually through shape language; Hand-drawn storyboard frames across ten sequences: The Promotion, The Gift, The Tragedy, The Accident, Another Dimension, The Vision, The Poison, The Journey Towards Truth, The Truth and Awakening; Environment concept art and a top-down level design; Animatics (about 1 minute 40 seconds); A 24-slide pre-production document and a mood-board poster.

chunks.title: Between Waking — stack and learning
chunks.text: Between Waking. Technologies: Storyboarding, Animatics, Game-design documentation, World-building, Concept art. Media available: Animatics, Poster, Pre-production deck.
